translations.text: A generation goes and a generation comes, but the earth remains forever.
All streams flow into the sea, yet the sea is not filled. To the place where the streams flow, there they return to flow again.
I set my heart on seeking and examining with wisdom everything that has happened under the sun, for God has given human beings a grievous task to occupy themselves with under the sun.
For who can eat and drink without him?
I praised all the dead, who had died before, more than the living, who are still alive.
For if two lie down together, they warm one another, but how can one person keep warm?
As he came out of his mother's womb, naked, so he will return and depart just as he came. He will take nothing from his labor to carry away in his hand.
For every person to whom God has given wealth and possessions, and whom he has enabled to eat from them, to receive his share, and to rejoice in his labor—this is a gift of God.
What advantage does the wise person have over the fool? For the poor person knows how to go about his life.
All this I saw, and I set my heart on all the deeds done under the sun, whenever one person exercised power over another to cause him suffering.

I praised joy, for there is nothing good for people under the sun except eating, drinking, and rejoicing. This will accompany a person in his toil throughout the days of his life, however many God has given him under the sun.
Let your clothes always be white, and let oil never be lacking on your head.
For even when the fool walks along the road, his understanding fails him, and everything he thinks is foolishness.
The fool has been placed in very high positions, while the rich will sit in low positions.
Bread is prepared for merriment, and wine and oil make the living glad, and everything obeys money.
Send your bread out upon the surface of the waters, for after many days of your life you will find it.
Give a share to seven, and also to eight, because you do not know what calamity will happen on the earth.
The Preacher made a great effort to find pleasing words and to write accurate texts of truthful words.
The words of the wise are like goads for oxen and like nails driven in; from written records they were given by one shepherd.
